boundary_rationale: A second-person-feminine-singular imperative pair opens the unit, “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh's glory has risen on you!” (web:Isa.60.1), matching ק֥וּמִי א֖וֹרִי (oshb:Isa.60.1, byte tier).
